Is there a table here?

Source: R/open.R
lake_is_table.Rd

lake_is_table() says whether uri holds a Delta Lake table: a _delta_log/ directory with at least one commit or checkpoint in it. It reads no log file, so a table it finds can still fail to open.

Usage

lake_is_table(uri, credentials = NULL)

Arguments

uri

Location of the table: the path of its directory, the one that holds _delta_log/.

credentials

A function of no arguments returning a bearer token, for tables on Azure. Not used for local paths.

Value

TRUE or FALSE.

See also

lake_open(), whose example also calls lake_is_table().

Examples

lake_is_table(tempdir())
#> [1] FALSE
